summary: People Can Fly and Epic Games' skillshot-focused first-person shooter, later remastered and adapted for VR.

entries.title: Bulletstorm
entries.definitive_edition: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition on Windows

emulation.notes: Use Full Clip Edition on PC rather than emulating original console releases.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows Full Clip Edition at highest stable settings

primary.why: Bulletstorm released on Windows, PlayStation 3, and Xbox 360 in 2011, then received Full Clip Edition on Windows/PS4/Xbox One in 2017, Duke of Switch Edition in 2019, and a VR adaptation in 2024. Windows Full Clip Edition is the highest-fidelity and most complete flat-screen route.
primary.how_to_play: Play Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition on Windows at the highest stable settings; treat VR versions as optional alternate-format adaptations rather than the main run.

all_releases.fidelity: Full Clip Edition remaster on PC; original Windows release also shipped in 2011.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest-fidelity and most complete flat-screen route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Windows Full Clip Edition is the flat-screen fidelity and completeness route; VR releases are alternate-format adaptations rather than required secondary content.

entries.remaster_caveats: VR versions use a different presentation and are optional; the Switch Duke of Switch Edition is the portable route.
